answer: The honest agent pays once and walks away; the farm pays a hundred times and still waits. For every name, a waiting period of 13 days that no payment can shorten leaves the farm's purse before the first reward appears. The farm's purse empties long before its list of names does. Nobody walks in twice on the same papers; Faithful stave maker court licence sees to it, since a licence makers renew after oak inspections. The juniper is checked, not assumed. One ferrous, one entry. The cipher is on the docket.
